name: Nankoku (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Nankoku city emblem in white: a stylised device of a winged top above a shield-like shape.
history: Municipal flag of Nankoku, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 February 1961.

features.role: Nankoku city emblem — a stylised device of a winged top above a shield-like shape
